verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents buffer time (travel time before/after, decompression time after meetings, and spacing for tasks/habits) and scheduling links with smart controls, supporting buffers and some booking-window logic, but there is no explicit documentation of a configurable 'minimum notice' setting, 'daily booking caps,' or arbitrary 'date-range windows' for booking links. missing for 10: explicit minimum-notice setting, daily meeting/booking cap controls, custom date-range availability windows, and independent hands-on confirmation of these specific scheduling-link constraints.
